regressions.name: Closed noise intervals that touch are not robustly distinguishable
A strict gap permits exact rational observations
Inclusive bounds and an open out-of-scope gap remain exact
Boolean identity, negative zero, non-JSON properties and malformed rational observations are refused
Forged scope, radius, responses, cost and non-null weights fail independent acceptance
An empty allowed grammar is an explicit complete negative result
An objective already determined needs no experiment
Exhaustion is not an impossibility certificate
A structural cache hit recomputes objectives, while changed nuisance invalidates its boundary
Competent centralized adaptive policy can strictly beat the static compiler

claims: Current tested compiler static optimum agrees with complete independent Cartesian grammar and direct subset enumeration on all 124 development/random cases.
The two supplied development families tie competent static and adaptive acquisition baselines; no acquisition advantage is established.
The explicit adaptive control beats the static compiler 2 versus 3 acquisition units.
Reference and compiler work meters count different logical operations. Their values are not a runtime speedup claim.
The reviewer is a separately delegated agent using no producer imports in reference.mjs; this is not institutional or arm's-length external review.
These are finite synthetic model tests, not held-out successor acceptance, physical validation, realized revenue or autonomous RSI.
No material mathematical correctness finding remains at the reviewed source within the bounded model. Model adequacy, authorization and deployment remain outside this review.

static.scope: Exact direct subset correctness reference; runtime is not an optimized conventional performance baseline.

adaptive.scope: Exact finite minimax adaptive policy; fresh independent bounded errors. Repeating a probe that can retain the entire belief cannot improve its worst-case value.
